observations.lumbar_at_setup: At 4.40s and 4.80s, the lower back shows a straight, flat profile without visible rounding or excessive arching.
observations.thoracic_at_setup: At 4.40s and 4.80s, the upper back is held in a straight line continuous with the rest of the spine, with no distinct rounding of the shoulders or thoracic spine.
observations.arms_long: Throughout the setup and pull (4.40s to 5.40s), the elbows remain fully extended and the arms are straight.
observations.slack_pull: Between 4.40s and 4.80s, the lifter pre-tensions the body and bar, and the bar leaves the floor smoothly without any sudden jerking motion.
observations.brace: At 4.40s, the lifter's midsection is visibly expanded and held rigid, maintaining this shape as the lift begins.
observations.hip_vs_shoulder_rise: From 4.80s to 5.20s, the hips and shoulders rise at the same rate, maintaining a constant torso angle relative to the floor.
observations.jerky_start: The bar transitions from stationary on the floor at 4.40s to moving upward at 4.80s in a smooth, continuous motion without sudden acceleration or jerking.

observations.past_the_knees: At 5.20s and 5.40s, the bar travels vertically past the knees in a straight line without hitting the knees or looping outward.

observations.lumbar_under_load: In the close-up frames from 4.80s to 5.40s, the lower back maintains its flat, neutral shape without any visible flexion or collapse.

observations.lean_back: At 5.60s and 6.20s, the lifter stands fully upright with a vertical torso, without leaning backward or hyperextending the spine.
observations.shrug: At 5.60s and 6.20s, the shoulders remain in a depressed, natural position without any upward shrugging motion.
